Mr. Shubhr Rastogi, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. V.S. Rawat, A.G.A. for the State.

Applicant was granted bail on 31.12.2024, in FIR No.293 of 2024, under Sections 323, 363, 366, 376(3), 376(2)(n), 302 & 506 IPC and Sections 3(a)/4(2), 5(l) &
6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and Section 3(2)(v) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, Police Station Bahadrabad,
District Haridwar.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Applicant was granted bail on 31.12.2024, in FIR No.293 of 2024, under Sections 323, 363, 366, 376(3), 376(2)(n), 302 & 506 IPC and Sections 3(a)/4(2), 5(l) &
6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and Section 3(2)(v) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, Police Station Bahadrabad,
District Haridwar.
Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that applicant is in custody for offence punishable under Section 3(1)(w) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989 also, but it has not been reflected on the bail order.
The Correction Application is allowed.
